title: Tormented spirit
wikitext:
[[File:TormentedSpirits.png|thumb|right]] '''Tormented Spirits''' are a special type of [[undead]] [[monster]]. Once spotted, these apparitions of dead criminals flee from the player with their ill-gotten gains. When a tormented spirit touch another monster, it imbues them a with buff that increases their danger, but also their reward. When a tormented spirit touches a {{c|rare|Rare}} or {{c|unique|Unique}} monster, it possesses it and makes them even more powerful, but also makes them more rewarding.{{cite web|author=Chris|date=November 27, 2014|title=Content Updated 1.3.0|url=http://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1111831|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=November 27, 2014}} This mechanic is also referred to as '''Torment'''. Tormented spirits are considered a form of [[Extra Content]]. ==Mechanics== Tormented spirits are {{c|unique|Unique}} monsters that can be randomly found throughout acts and [[map]]s. Tormented spirits are unable to attack directly. Once a player gets within range, it will attempt to flee from the player while also attempting to pass through other monsters along the way, stopping every few seconds. Any {{c|normal|Normal}} and {{c|magic|Magic}} monsters that the spirit passes through receive a "{{c|torment|Touch}}" modifier based on the spirit type. If the tormented spirit touches a {{c|rare|Rare}} or {{c|unique|Unique}} monster, it will go inside that monster and possess it, despawning itself and giving the monster a "{{c|torment|Grip}}" modifier. Tormented spirits cannot affect other tormented spirits. If a tormented spirit stays alive long enough without possessing anything it will eventually despawn itself, leaving no items. Certain effects can cause monsters to spawn in with a Touch or Grip modifier already applied. Monsters that have been touched or possessed by a tormented spirit receive increased damage and attack, cast, and movement speed, along with any special effects given by that specific tormented spirit, as well as 25% increased [[item quantity]] and [[item rarity]] for a Touch modifier, and 50% increased item rarity for a Grip modifier. If a tormented spirit is killed, it is guaranteed to drop one rare item. If a rare monster is possessed, at least two rare items are guaranteed to drop, and if a unique monster is possessed, at least three rare items are guaranteed to drop.Verbal confirmation from Chris Wilson on the nl_Kripp twitch stream, April 21, 2015. Tormented spirits spawn in with a hidden {{c|mod|90% less damage taken}} modifier that tapers off to 0% over 15 seconds after they become active. For each monster they touch, they take 5% increased damage. Each tormented spirit can touch up a maximum of 50 enemies. {{il|Fairgraves' Tricorne}} allows the player to receive a Touch modifier if they touch a tormented spirit. The [[Speaker of the Dead]] keystone allows tormented spirits to possess the player, granting you its Grip modifier and allowing you to touch up to 40 monsters. ==Torment modifiers== Note: information is based on inferences from metadata and may not be 100% accurate. ===Basic=== {| class="wikitable" |- ! The Betrayer and Heretic Touched monsters also have a chance to drop a specific item (scarab or map depending on the spirit). The chance is supposedly 10%, following the metadata which may not be accurate.
The scarabs dropped this way doesn't seem to be affected by modifiers on the atlas tree, as notable nodes such as [[Loved by the Sun]] doesn't prevent abyss scarabs to drop.
